notes: Hair › Wash & care: all 9 planned kinds kept (no merges needed). I cut the Shampoo SKU list from 19 to 5. I dropped all 13 K-time SKUs (one shop dominated the list) and removed the JVN repeats. The JVN Embody/Nurture/Revive ranges now sit in the brand register, with one JVN model kept per kind. I also dropped the K-time Keratin Code mask and the Sisley colour and blonde masks as near-duplicates. I added 17 archetypes: Head & Shoulders (1961 confirmed), Pantene Pro-V (1990), Nizoral A-D, Selsun Blue, the shampoo bar (Lush, 1987), It's a 10 Miracle Leave-In, Davines OI All in One Milk, Olaplex No.3, the K18 leave-in mask, Aussie 3 Minute Miracle, Moroccanoil Treatment, Kérastase Elixir Ultime, Olaplex No.7, Batiste, Klorane Oat Milk, Minipoo (the first commercial dry shampoo, 1940s) and Aveda Invati (under Scalp treatment). Bond repair is now a type under Hair mask. Brands: 10 register entries. Traditions: Moroccan argan oil (UNESCO ICH) and Champi. Unverified or left out: Moroccanoil's claim to be the originator of argan hair oil is the maker's own, so it is worded as a claim. I could not confirm launch years for Olaplex No.3/No.7, Elixir Ultime, It's a 10, the Klorane dry shampoo or the original Invati, so these are left blank. Batiste's country is not confirmed (left blank). Nizoral's originating maker is not confirmed; the US labeler (Kramer Laboratories, per DailyMed) appears as a version note. The co-wash type is listed as an attribute without its own source. Detangling spray, Scalp scrub and Scalp treatment keep their old retailer sources.
